If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase early-period forecast by 1.0–1.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a downward trend, shift mid-period forecast upward by 0.8–1.2% to reflect renewed bullishness.  
If sentiment is 0.00 in last 2 days and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias in late forecast to avoid stagnation.  
If sentiment is 0.67–0.83 and forecast is volatile, smooth mid-period forecast by averaging adjacent values to reduce noise.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is rising, cap late-period forecast at +2.0% above peak to prevent overbought bias.
